protocol: Champion re-derivation: experiment 12's committed recipe (same sha256-pinned UCI hour.csv, same feature contract, same MLP architecture + hyperparameters, seed 42), scored once on the frozen 8-week test window; reproduction gate |ΔMAE| ≤ params reproduction_tolerance. Serving: native torch vs ONNX Runtime behind one FastAPI service, warmed at startup; parity gate on a seeded probe grid (max-abs, standardized-y space) before any serving stage may run. Benchmark: real subprocess service per backend, warm-up excluded, ~300 requests per concurrency cell (1/4/16/64), median of 3 repeats, batch sizes 1/8/32/128, fresh-process RSS probes, byte-identical seeded payload streams. Docker: multi-stage build from the repo-root context, model baked in, image size + layer breakdown measured with the daemon, compose smoke against /health /ready /predict.
limits: Single laptop, no GPU, one uvicorn worker, one model: absolute numbers do not transfer; the paired native-vs-ONNX deltas and the shape of the curves are the transferable read.
The load driver runs on the same machine as the service — localhost latency has no network term, and the CPU is shared between driver and service under high concurrency.
Fresh-process RSS is the steady state after warm-up, not a peak under load; the image size is the uncompressed on-disk total.
Cost per 1k predictions uses measured throughput with a declared 65 W system draw (no wall meter) and $0.30 per kWh — an assumption, stated next to the number, not a measurement.
